targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "locust_requests" and
      r["_field"] == "status_code" and
      r.name =~ /^ur/
  )
  |> group(columns: ["name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 30.0 }))
  |> yield(name: "rps_30s")
